sql_templates.purpose: Identify latest sector breadths and ranks by stage 2 participation.
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_breadth AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.sector, 
        sd.pct_above_50dma, 
        ma.stage2_pct 
    FROM 
        breadth.sector_daily sd
    JOIN 
        breadth.ma_pct_above ma 
        ON sd.snapshot_date = ma.snapshot_date
    WHERE 
        sd.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM breadth.sector_daily)
), ranked_sectors AS (
    SELECT 
        sector, 
        pct_above_50dma, 
        stage2_pct, 
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY stage2_pct DESC) AS sector_rank
    FROM 
        latest_breadth
)
SELECT 
    sector, 
    pct_above_50dma, 
    stage2_pct, 
    sector_rank
FROM 
    ranked_sectors
WHERE 
    sector_rank <= 10;
